images.prompt: Architectural photograph, Julius Shulman / Iwan Baan style. A small minimalist cabin made of black weathered steel and board-formed concrete, a single long rectangular volume with one huge frameless window, perched on a bare granite outcrop above a dark Arctic sea in Lofoten, Norway. Blue polar twilight, low pink sun on the horizon, thin snow on the rocks, one warm light inside. Shot on medium-format camera, 45mm lens, perfectly vertical lines, deep natural colour, fine detail, no people, no text, no watermark.

Architectural photograph of a low courtyard house of pale sand-coloured concrete in the Alentejo, Portugal. Hard midday sun, razor-sharp black shadows from a deep concrete pergola falling across a white wall and a gravel courtyard with a single old olive tree. Deep blue cloudless sky. Minimal, monolithic, almost abstract composition, Swiss architectural photography, medium format, perfectly vertical lines, no people, no text, no watermark.

Architectural photograph of a long, slender board-formed concrete house cantilevered dramatically out of a steep mossy cliff above a Norwegian fjord, Hardanger. Golden hour, the low sun raking across the concrete so every formwork line and tie-hole casts a tiny shadow, long shadows of pine trees across the facade, full-height glazing reflecting the warm sky, mist on the fjord far below. Medium format, 35mm lens, perfectly vertical lines, rich but natural colour, no people, no text, no watermark.

Architectural photograph at blue hour of a house built from black basalt and grey concrete on the edge of a volcanic sea cliff in the Azores. Deep blue dusk sky, the Atlantic below, warm golden light glowing from a long horizontal strip window and a small lit infinity pool glowing turquoise on the terrace. Moody, quiet, cinematic, medium format, long exposure smooth sea, perfectly vertical lines, no people, no text, no watermark.

Photograph of a quiet architecture studio in an old Lisbon warehouse: long pale oak tables covered with white and grey concrete architectural massing models of cliff houses, tracing paper drawings, a brass desk lamp. A single hard shaft of late afternoon sunlight from a tall window cuts diagonally across the room, casting long crisp shadows of the models across the table. Muted warm off-white palette, dust in the light, calm, editorial interior photography, 35mm, no people, no text, no watermark.
